terminalSettings.title: Terminal
terminalSettings.leaveAppDescription: While you're using a terminal on your phone, Orca shrinks it to fit your screen. When you close the app or switch away, this controls whether it stays at phone size (so interactive CLI tools don't reflow) or resizes back to your desktop. You can always use Restore on the desktop banner to resize manually.
terminalSettings.noPairedDesktops: No paired desktops yet. Pair one to control terminal behavior.
terminalSettings.textSizeDescription: Scale the terminal text. Smaller sizes fit more columns with side margins; larger sizes show fewer columns — drag sideways to pan. You can also pinch to zoom in the terminal itself, which updates this setting. Per-device display only; doesn't change the desktop terminal.
terminalSettings.keyboardInputDescription: Autocomplete, autocorrect, and spelling suggestions apply only to buffered command input. Use the double-chevron button above the keyboard to switch from live input, then edit your command before tapping Send. Off by default to avoid rewriting commands, flags, or paths.

troubleshootCommonIssues.allowNotifications: Check that system settings allow Orca notifications and that Focus or Do Not Disturb is off.
troubleshootCommonIssues.notificationNetwork: Try cellular or another Wi-Fi network. If alerts arrive after switching, your network may be delaying delivery.
troubleshootCommonIssues.sameNetwork: Both devices must be on the same LAN (unless connected through Tailscale).
troubleshootCommonIssues.sameSubnet: Ethernet and WiFi must share the same subnet.
troubleshootCommonIssues.reconnectWifi: Try reconnecting WiFi on both devices.
troubleshootCommonIssues.macosFirewall: macOS: System Settings → Network → Firewall — allow Orca.
troubleshootCommonIssues.windowsFirewall: Windows: Defender Firewall → Allow app — enable Orca for Private networks.
troubleshootCommonIssues.restrictedNetwork: Corporate/school networks may block P2P — try a personal hotspot.
troubleshootCommonIssues.openDesktop: Orca must be open on your desktop to accept connections.
troubleshootCommonIssues.restartDesktop: Try restarting Orca — the companion server starts on launch.
troubleshootCommonIssues.pairAfterUpdate: After an update, you may need to re-pair via QR code.
troubleshootCommonIssues.wifiSignal: Check WiFi signal strength on your phone.
troubleshootCommonIssues.retryHost: Go back to the host list and tap your host to retry.
troubleshootCommonIssues.restartBothApps: Restart both apps if timeouts persist.
troubleshootCommonIssues.keepTailscaleOn: Host addresses like 100.x.x.x or *.ts.net connect through Tailscale — keep it ON.
troubleshootCommonIssues.restartTailscale: iOS/Android can silently wedge the tunnel: toggle Tailscale off and back on in the Tailscale app.
troubleshootCommonIssues.checkTailnet: Check the desktop is awake and shows as connected in your tailnet.
troubleshootCommonIssues.updateTailscale: Update the Tailscale app — recent releases fix reconnect bugs.
troubleshootCommonIssues.vpnRouting: Non-Tailscale VPNs can route local traffic through a remote server.
troubleshootCommonIssues.disableVpn: Disable that VPN or enable split tunneling / "Allow LAN".

useTroubleshootDiagnostics.noPairedHosts: None — scan a QR to pair
